### What's new in 1.3.1
- **Bullet holes.** Missed shots leave holes on containers, walls and the ground, including inside the scope view. Up to 45 stay on screen; the oldest fades out when a new one lands, so they never slow the game down.
- **Tarkov-style EOTech holo.** The sight is rebuilt with an open, see-through window, a thin hood, and the control panel with its brightness button below the window. The folded-up rear iron sight now sits at the bottom of your view when aiming, like in raid.
- **Holo reticle** is now a ring with four tick marks and a centre dot.

### Install
Download **RaidReady.exe** below and double-click it. Unsigned exe, so if SmartScreen appears: **More info → Run anyway**.
